name: mitral-stenosis-explainer
description: Osmosis-style mitral stenosis explainer built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render MitralStenosisExplainer out/mitral-stenosis-explainer.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --concurrency=1 --browser-executable="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
